purpose: Native Windows endpoint behind a routed FreeBSD hop: Windows loss/jitter, routed IPv4/IPv6 coverage and a pre-registered SackOpts controlled-null attempt

topology.basis: Source and Windows target use distinct prefixes on one virtual Ethernet segment; each side routes the other prefix through the FreeBSD router, so forwarding is at layer 3 even though the frames share a segment

native.basis: Native Windows SACK support (registry SackOpts absent) observed in prior studies; hypothesis, not an independent toggle

feasibility.stopping_rule: Phase null runs only if all six feasibility reports are valid, every one is no-difference, and no SYN-ACK in any arm carries SACK-permitted. Otherwise the SackOpts control is declared ineffective, phase null is not executed and its planned reports are recorded as not executed by the stopping rule.

sackopts_control: HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters SackOpts DWORD 0, set before a full restart and deleted before a second restart; native truth must show the registry value and a boot time later than the recorded change

impairment.delay_profile: 128 empirical uniform samples interpolated from 15 to 25 ms (bsd-delay-profile.txt)
impairment.scope: Only forwarded TCP443 SYN-ACKs from the Windows target to the explicit source, on the router's outgoing interface; control TCP8443 and probes are forwarded unshaped

diagnostics.meaning: Descriptive temporal flags only; lack of flags cannot establish IID or stationarity

limitations: Same Windows 11 VM and FreeBSD VM as earlier studies; a fresh routed configuration, not physically independent held-out hardware
Exact binomial bounds and numerical gates are conditional on IID Bernoulli sampling, which this experiment cannot establish
Strict complete-pair inference stays unresolved under loss; all planned invalid, missing, unresolved and not-executed outcomes remain in denominators
Routed IPv4/IPv6 through one FreeBSD hop without NAT; the Linux corpus supplies NAT/proxy fixtures
Impairment is FreeBSD dummynet on the forwarded reply path, not Linux netem and not a Windows-native impairment
macOS source kernel RSTs remain enabled; captures on the shared segment include both forwarded legs
Resources measure macOS scanner/runner children, not Windows or router CPU/RSS
